snippet.title: The Narrative behind TMNT: Splintered Fate - Extended Version
snippet.description:
Our Narrative team discusses the King's Gambit Update and the big reveal at the end of it. Watch Tom Waltz, Thomas Beekers and Matt Wallace reveal their narrative secrets.

Want even more secret lore? We’ve released another Extended Version focused on the Voice Acting, packed with extra quotes and behind-the-scenes secrets. Check it our on our channel!
